name: Hondo Ohnaka
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Hondo's Weequay pirate helmet with iconic goggles mounted atop a plunder pole draped in stolen Republic banners
A Florrum cantina sign — skull-and-crossbones over a spice barrel, ringed with electrostaffs and cutlasses
Hondo's crossed electrostaff and cutlass over an open credits chest, with a tiny holo-ransom note for a Sith Lord
vehicleSuggestions: Corona-class armed frigate (Hondo's Florrum flagship — pirate king's mobile base for raids and ransoms)
Modified Sheathipede-class shuttle (hostage transport from the Count Dooku capture incident)
Ohnaka Transport Solutions cargo skiff (Black Spire Outpost smuggling front from the Resistance era)

factionTrait.name: Tactician Champion
factionTrait.text: A tactician moves the turn token +1 step when they make a claim action.

uniqueTraits.name: I Have Altered the Deal
uniqueTraits.text: At the end of Hondo Ohnaka's activation, roll one die. If you roll a 1 or 2, you may remove a boon or blight from a model within that many hexes of Hondo Ohnaka and place it on a different model within that many hexes.

ultimate.name: Handsome Price
alternateNames: This Effort Is No Longer Profitable
ultimate.text: Choose one blight for each Florrum Pirate within range. Each enemy champion within range gains those blights.

plotSkills.name: Boarding Party
plotSkills.text: Remove any number of Florrum Pirates from the battlefield. Then place them on hexes within 2 hexes of Hondo Ohnaka.

clashSkills.name: Mark the Prize
clashSkills.text: Place up to two objective hexes on empty non-objective hexes within range. Remove them at the end of the clash phase.

clashSkills.name: No Match for My Men
alternateNames: Speak Softly, Drive a Big Tank

traits.name: Crew Gets Paid
traits.text: When Hondo Ohnaka rolls a blank on his I Have Altered the Deal roll, the Florrum Pirates may gain the boon of your choice.

plotSkills.name: Strip the Wreck
plotSkills.text: Gain the boon of your choice.

plotSkills.name: Weequay Blaster Volley
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: The target gains the blight of your choice.

clashSkills.name: Unload the Hold
clashSkills.text: Move all boons and blights from the Florrum Pirates to a friendly model within range.

clashSkills.name: Weequay Blaster Volley
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: The target gains the blight of your choice.
